data_backfill_runs_state_check.name: data_backfill_runs_state_check
data_backfill_runs_state_check.value:
"data_backfill_runs"."target_environment" IN ('development', 'production')
        AND "data_backfill_runs"."status" IN ('running', 'failed', 'completed')
        AND "data_backfill_runs"."stage" IN (
          'payments',
          'stripeEvents',
          'telegramAccessTokens',
          'telegramUserBindings',
          'monthlyReportRuns',
          'emailCampaignLeads'
        )
        AND "data_backfill_runs"."batch_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 500
        AND "data_backfill_runs"."next_row_index" >= 0
        AND JSONB_TYPEOF("data_backfill_runs"."source_row_counts") = 'object'
        AND JSONB_TYPEOF("data_backfill_runs"."stats") = 'object'
        AND (
          "data_backfill_runs"."status" <> 'completed'
          OR "data_backfill_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

invoice_sequences_ranges_check.name: invoice_sequences_ranges_check
invoice_sequences_ranges_check.value:
"invoice_sequences"."sequence_year" BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999
        AND "invoice_sequences"."sequence_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12
        AND "invoice_sequences"."last_sequence" > 0

invoices_ranges_check.name: invoices_ranges_check
invoices_ranges_check.value:
"invoices"."sequence_year" BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999
        AND "invoices"."sequence_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12
        AND "invoices"."sequence_number" > 0
        AND "invoices"."amount_minor" >= 0
        AND "invoices"."currency" IN ('pln', 'eur')

purchase_side_effects_lifecycle_check.name: purchase_side_effects_lifecycle_check
purchase_side_effects_lifecycle_check.value:
BTRIM("purchase_side_effects"."deduplication_key") <> ''
        AND JSONB_TYPEOF("purchase_side_effects"."payload") = 'object'
        AND "purchase_side_effects"."status" IN (
          'pending',
          'sending',
          'sent',
          'skipped',
          'failed',
          'dead_letter'
        )
        AND (
          "purchase_side_effects"."status" <> 'dead_letter'
          OR "purchase_side_effects"."dead_lettered_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

purchases_currency_check.name: purchases_currency_check
purchases_currency_check.value:
"purchases"."currency" IN ('pln', 'eur')
        AND ("purchases"."checkout_currency" IS NULL
          OR "purchases"."checkout_currency" IN ('pln', 'eur'))
        AND ("purchases"."settlement_currency" IS NULL
          OR LENGTH(BTRIM("purchases"."settlement_currency")) = 3)

purchases_money_ranges_check.name: purchases_money_ranges_check
purchases_money_ranges_check.value:
("purchases"."settlement_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "purchases"."settlement_amount_minor" >= 0)
        AND ("purchases"."stripe_fee_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "purchases"."stripe_fee_amount_minor" >= 0)

purchases_locale_language_check.name: purchases_locale_language_check
purchases_locale_language_check.value:
("purchases"."checkout_locale" IS NULL OR "purchases"."checkout_locale" IN ('ru', 'en', 'pl'))
        AND ("purchases"."lesson_language" IS NULL OR "purchases"."lesson_language" IN ('ru', 'en'))

stripe_events_evidence_check.name: stripe_events_evidence_check
stripe_events_evidence_check.value:
BTRIM("stripe_events"."stripe_event_id") <> ''
        AND BTRIM("stripe_events"."event_type") <> ''
        AND JSONB_TYPEOF("stripe_events"."payload") = 'object'
        AND (
          NOT "stripe_events"."provider_payload_verified"
          OR "stripe_events"."stripe_created_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

stripe_events_lifecycle_check.name: stripe_events_lifecycle_check
stripe_events_lifecycle_check.value:
"stripe_events"."processing_status" IN (
          'pending',
          'processing',
          'processed',
          'skipped',
          'failed',
          'dead_letter'
        )
        AND "stripe_events"."attempt_count" >= 0
        AND (
          "stripe_events"."processing_status" <> 'processing'
          OR (
            NULLIF(BTRIM("stripe_events"."lease_token"), '') IS NOT NULL
            AND "stripe_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
        AND (
          "stripe_events"."processing_status" <> 'dead_letter'
          OR "stripe_events"."dead_lettered_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND (
          "stripe_events"."processing_status" NOT IN ('processed', 'skipped')
          OR "stripe_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
